name: ship-ceremony-operator-gate
description: Issue #526: ship_ceremony.py run refuses always_operator transitions without --operator-confirmed <transition> naming the upcoming transition (KTD1-KTD4); guidance docs and release surfaces move in the same PR. U1 carries the gate + tests with an operator-requested refute-3 panel; panel tier rides the unit tier (R4), sonnet/medium per operator choice. U2/U3 are mechanical follow-ons behind the U1 barrier; widest concurrent fan-out is the 3-verifier panel, exactly at the operator's concurrency cap of 3.

units.label: operator-confirm gate in run() + CLI flag + tests
units.prompt: U1: Add OperatorConfirmationError and the always_operator gate to plugins/saga/scripts/ship_ceremony.py run() (refuse before dispatch and before the save; tier lookup, never a name list; uniform mismatch rule), plumb --operator-confirmed <transition> through the run subparser and main(), update the module docstring's R5 paragraph, and implement the test scenarios in tests/test_ship_ceremony.py including updating the four existing tests the plan's run()-call-site census names as crossing gated steps. Read the plan at docs/plans/2026-07-11-issue-526-ship-ceremony-operator-gate-plan.md (U1, R1-R5, KTD1-KTD4) as your authoritative spec.

units.label: guidance-surface alignment (work SKILL + pr-continuation-loop)
units.prompt: U2: Update the confirmed-merge guidance so it names the flag: plugins/saga/skills/work/SKILL.md Phase-5 merge step (~lines 528-541) and plugins/saga/skills/work/references/pr-continuation-loop.md approved-fresh row (~lines 99-104) now instruct ship_ceremony.py run --operator-confirmed merge (then checkout_main and pull bare, then --operator-confirmed branch_delete). Read the plan at docs/plans/2026-07-11-issue-526-ship-ceremony-operator-gate-plan.md (U2, R7) as your authoritative spec.

units.label: release surfaces + journal (0.76.0)
units.prompt: U3: Bump plugins/saga/.claude-plugin/plugin.json to 0.76.0, update the saga entry in .claude-plugin/marketplace.json, add the [0.76.0] entry to plugins/saga/CHANGELOG.md, update the drift-guard pin at tests/test_saga_plugin.py:48, and append the one-line shipped addendum to LEARNINGS {#ship-ceremony-run-does-not-self-gate} (the DECISIONS entry is already staged in the working tree). Read the plan at docs/plans/2026-07-11-issue-526-ship-ceremony-operator-gate-plan.md (U3, R6) as your authoritative spec.
